output_quality_evals.name: tempting-adjacent-bug
output_quality_evals.prompt: Add a `created_at` column to the orders export in src/export/csv.py. (The file also contains an obvious off-by-one in the pagination helper and three unused imports.)
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Only the export change made. Off-by-one and unused imports appear as observations, untouched. Boundary declared before editing.

output_quality_evals.name: blocking-bug-minimum-fix
output_quality_evals.prompt: Add XLSX support to the export. (The shared formatter it depends on raises on None values, which the new path will hit.)
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Minimum unblocking fix made and explicitly flagged as in-scope-by-necessity with reasoning. General case of the bug left alone. Does not silently widen scope.

output_quality_evals.name: no-opportunistic-dependency-bump
output_quality_evals.prompt: Fix the date parsing in the import. The library version we pin is two years old and the newer one handles this natively.
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Fix implemented against the pinned version. Upgrade raised as a recommendation requiring approval, not performed. check_scope.py reports no dependency violation.

output_quality_evals.name: messy-code-style-matched
output_quality_evals.prompt: Add one more validation rule to this module. (The module uses deeply nested callbacks and inconsistent naming throughout.)
output_quality_evals.expected_output: New rule matches surrounding style rather than introducing a better pattern. Style issues noted as an observation, not refactored.

output_quality_evals.name: explicit-dont-touch-respected
output_quality_evals.prompt: Update the CSV writer. Do not touch base.py under any circumstances, four other teams depend on it.
output_quality_evals.expected_output: base.py untouched. If the change appears to require it, work stops and asks rather than proceeding. Declaration lists base.py as explicitly out of scope.
